propositions: Two capability decisions (NativeOutput selection and prompt-cache attachment) use provider name string matching instead of reading ModelProfile, causing silent failure for Bedrock-hosted Claude models whose capabilities differ from direct API
Naive profile reads would incorrectly route Claude to NativeOutput despite rebar's deliberate choice of PromptedOutput, requiring a rebar override table to preserve tested behavior
Model capabilities must be readable from both model objects and lazy provider-name strings without importing optional vendor SDKs, requiring a registry of profile resolvers from pydantic_ai.profiles
The override table must use profile capability FIELDS and TYPE checks rather than provider name patterns to avoid reintroducing the string matching this story removes
A new leaf module capabilities.py is required to keep providers.py under its S1-attested 300 LOC criterion while separating capability interpretation from provider construction
Bedrock-hosted Claude testing must use field-presence detection instead of isinstance checks to avoid importing boto3 in CI, with verification against real profiles in a boto3-gated layer
